title: Verify: Config loader, logger and lock unit tests
summary: Unit tests for config defaults/validation, JSON logging and lock exclusivity
description: Write TDD-style unit tests from R1 using fstest.MapFS, a bytes.Buffer and t.TempDir only.
acceptance_criteria: Logger output decodes as JSON with msg and level
Second Acquire returns ErrLocked and release re-enables it

steps.action: Add TestLoadFS_Defaults loading a MapFS yaml with only world, repo_path, work_root and asserting PollInterval 30s, ExecTimeout 30m, MaxRetries 2, AutoPublish false, Provider.Kind mock; add TestLoadFS_Invalid table-driven over empty world, exec_timeout -1s, max_budget_usd -1 asserting error text contains the field name
Call New("info", &buf), log Info("hello"), json.Unmarshal the line and assert msg == hello and level == INFO; assert a Debug line is not emitted
In t.TempDir, Acquire(path,"a") succeeds, Acquire(path,"b") errors.Is ErrLocked; a Lock with owner b built via a stale copy does not remove the file; after Release of a, Acquire(path,"b") succeeds
